rules: Official inDrive evidence establishes partner presence; broad country/region evidence may only inherit existing Atlas geography.

Existing geography-level demand/fare evidence may be reused only on the same exact route/destination pool; no partner capture or commercial overlay is copied.
Annual demand is admitted only when the source semantics are explicitly one-way passenger-trips or an explicitly labeled destination pool; otherwise production value remains null.
